rows.title: Free Treatment for People Living with PTSD from Military Service

content.title: Free Treatment for People Living with PTSD from Military Service
content.who: Veterans (not in regular service) living with PTSD from their military service.
content.what: Treatment with one of two methods, Somatic Experiencing (SE) or prolonged exposure (PE), by certified therapists. The program includes filling out questionnaires, clinical assessments and follow-up by Metiv, and the data is used for clinical research.

content.title: Metiv Space for Children
content.who: Parents who are unsure whether their child needs therapy, who are on a waiting list for treatment, or who have questions about their child.
content.what: A one-time parent-and-child play session with professionals in childhood trauma, whom you can ask questions. This is not therapy and not an assessment.
content.location: Metiv Children, Givat Shaul, Herzog Medical Center, floor -1, Jerusalem. Tuesday afternoons and Wednesday mornings, with advance registration.
content.process: You fill out a short questionnaire, after which a call or an introductory meeting is offered.
